tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// theg pa chen po'i smon lam bzhugs so// dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i// lus can kun gyi bsod nams ye shes tshogs// myur du bsgrubs nas tshe 'di kho na la// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la 'god par shog /bdag gis dus gsum dge ba ci bsags pa// nam mkha'i mtha' gtugs gyur pa'i sems can kun// bla med theg pa chen po'i snod gyur te// kun kyang rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bdag nyid shog /bdag kyang sangs rgyas ma thob bar// skye dang skye bar gnas bzang po// rigs bzang spyod pa bzang ba dang*// grogs bzang bla mas rjes 'dzin shog /tshul khrims dag cing mkhas la sgrim// rnam par dag cing rgyu gcig pa// bskal bzang spyod pas rnam brgyan te// thos nas gzhan la ston par shog /mgo bor bla ma'i cod pan 'chang*// lag pas thabs shes rdor dril 'dzin// ngag tu gsang sngags rgyal po bzlas// yid kyis zung 'jug bsgom par shog /'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar// bla ma lha dang mi 'bral zhing*// bsgrub la bar chad med pa dang*// bstan la bya ba byed par shog /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par// gang gi lam gyis grol 'gyur pa// de yis sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ces 'di'i shlo ka gong ma drug po 'di 'phags pas mdzad cing*/ 'og ma gcig 'di rgyud sambu ṭa las 'byung ba'i smon lam yin no// bkra shis ni/ mtshungs med bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// mthu stobs dbang phyug bla ma brgyud par bcas// mtshan nas brjod dam cung zad dran yang rung*// bkra shis 'phel zhing skye rgu bde legs shog /padma'i lte bar bdud bzhi'i steng na brjid// yon tan mtha' yas ye shes lnga yi dngos// he ru ka dpal bdag med rnal 'byor ma// bkra shis des ni skye rgu bde legs shog /sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru// chos bzhin sgrub par byed pa'i gang zag la// bar chad srung zhing skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i// chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog

/nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter mnga' zhing*// gnod sbyin nor 'chang dbang po kun gyi rje// byang phyogs skyong ba'i mgon po dzambha la// dngos grub mchog stsol nor lha'i bkra shis shog /gnas 'dir nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs// nyi ma'i gung yang bde legs shing*// nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa// dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis shog /ces sogs ci rigs par bya'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ bha ba tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
